 "description": "An instant in time, per ISO 8601 / RFC 3339, with a mandatory offset. Recipients MUST apply the offset, and\nMUST NOT read the date and time components as local time. Encodings of the same instant are equivalent and MUST\nbehave identically: `2027-07-22T00:00:00Z` and `2027-07-22T04:00:00+04:00` identify the same moment.\n\nIssuers SHOULD emit UTC, using `Z` or `+00:00`. The negative zero offset `-00:00` MUST NOT be used. Fractional\nseconds are optional and carry no specified precision; implementations MUST accept both their presence and\ntheir absence.\n",

chunks.text:
List Bank Service Initiation Attestation Events > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AETPPAttestationDataAction1Codes

{
 "type": "string",
 "enum": [
 "Deleted",
 "Retained",
 "Anonymised",
 "ArchivedRestricted"
 ],
 "description": "The action taken by the TPP for the category of data indicated by `DataCategory`, with the following definitions:\n\n* `Deleted`: The data has been deleted by the TPP.\n\n* `Retained`: The data is retained by the TPP in its original form.\n\n* `Anonymised`: The data is retained by the TPP in an effectively anonymised form.\n\n* `ArchivedRestricted`: The data is retained by the TPP in an archive to which access is restricted."
}

chunks.text:
List Bank Service Initiation Attestation Events > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AEPaymentTPPAttestationDataCategory1Codes

{
 "type": "string",
 "enum": [
 "AllConsentedData",
 "ReadAccountsBasic",
 "ReadAccountsDetail",
 "ReadBalances",
 "ReadRefundAccount",
 "AnalyticsData",
 "AuditRecords"
 ],
 "description": "The category of data to which the attestation applies, with the following definitions:\n\n* `AllConsentedData`: All data for the consent is qualified by the same `DataActionType`.\n\n* A Permission Code: Where the TPP is retaining some data and deleting other data, the Permission Code\nidentifying the data cluster to which the `DataActionType` applies.\n\n* `AnalyticsData`: Data derived from the consented data for analytics purposes.\n\n* `AuditRecords`: Records generated based on data access that may contain elements of the consented data."
}

chunks.text:
List Bank Service Initiation Attestation Events > OpenAPI definition #/components/schemas/AETPPAttestationRetentionReason1Codes

{
 "type": "string",
 "enum": [
 "RegulatoryOrLegalObligation",
 "FraudSecurityOrCompliance",
 "ComplaintOrDispute",
 "ExplicitCustomerAgreement",
 "UserRequestedHistory",
 "AnonymisedOrAggregatedData",
 "Other"
 ],
 "description": "Indicates the reason for retaining the consented data, with the following definitions:\n\n* `RegulatoryOrLegalObligation`: The data is retained to meet a regulatory or legal obligation.\n\n* `FraudSecurityOrCompliance`: The data is retained for fraud, security or compliance purposes.\n\n* `ComplaintOrDispute`: The data is retained in connection with an open complaint or dispute.\n\n* `ExplicitCustomerAgreement`: The data is retained under an explicit agreement with the customer.\n\n* `UserRequestedHistory`: The data is retained because the User requested their history is maintained.\n\n* `AnonymisedOrAggregatedData`: The data is retained in an anonymised or aggregated form.\n\n* `Other`: The data is retained for another reason, which must be described in `RetentionReasonDescription`."
}
